## Changes Since Previous Read
- **Stage: 4 → 5. THE REGIME BROKE.** After ten sessions of grind, the pre-committed Stage-5 trigger fired on the number the last three reads named. This is a trigger-honoring transition, not a discretionary one — and the report states below exactly what would reverse it.
- **Total score: −4 → −8 (−4).** The largest single-read deterioration of the episode, after the first zero-movement read. **Four lenses moved, all in the same direction:** Macro −1→−2, Breadth 0→−1, Cross-asset 0→−1, Geopolitical −1→−2.
- **THE FOMC RESOLVED HAWKISH.** Rates held at 3.50–3.75% for a sixth meeting, but **9-3 with Hammack, Kashkari and Logan dissenting in favor of a quarter-point HIKE** — a hike-side dissent bloc, not a dovish hold. Warsh deliberately withheld forward guidance ("we need to observe market reaction… direct and unfiltered"). **Bond markets rejected it: the 30Y yield hit its highest level since 2007**, and the reporting frames the day as an early credibility test Warsh did not pass ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/fed-rate-decision-july-2026.html), [CNBC analysis](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/kevin-warsh-fed-treasury-yields-inflation-credibility-interest-rates.html), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/29/economy/fed-rate-decision-july)).
- **THE ROTATION THESIS DIED — the split closed by everything going down together.** For eight sessions this report's central finding was DJI resilience vs NDX weakness. On Jul 29 **all five indices fell, and DJI was the WORST performer at −2.19%** (SPX −1.52%, Comp −1.74%, NDX −2.06%, RUT −1.61%). The 8.7-point DJI/NDX drawdown spread compressed to **8.4 points by DJI falling, not NDX recovering.** Contained rotation became broad de-risking in one session.
- **VXN CROSSED 30 — the bearish trigger FIRED. 28.61 → 30.84 (+7.79%),** a new episode high and the largest one-day VXN expansion of the episode. **Vol expanded through the event; it did not crush.** Est. TQQQ IV ~93%.
- **VIX PIERCED 20 AND THEN RETREATED. Derived Jul 29 close ≈ 20.66** (19.18 ÷ 0.9284, from the supplied −7.16% day change); **19.18 on the Jul 30 print.** The "through 20 **and holds**" trigger fired on the level and **failed on the hold** — a genuinely important distinction, and the single strongest argument against the Stage-5 call made here.
- **TQQQ STRUCTURE FLIPPED TO DOWNTURN. $57.75 (Jul 29 close, retrieved).** That is **−24.0% below the ~$76 4-week high with VXN 30.84 ≥ 25** — both conditions met. The prior read flagged this level (~$60.80) as ~1.1% away and inside its own estimate's error band. **It fired with room to spare.**

- **The 10Y easing trend BROKE. 4.604 → 4.622 (+0.39%),** ending the two-session relief the last read called "corroborated." The long end moved far more violently.
- **GEOPOLITICS ESCALATED MATERIALLY.** **US completed strikes on Iran; Trump said it's "our turn" after an intercepted Iranian attack on US forces**; new sanctions on two Iranian firms. **Brent spiked ~7% intraday to ~$90.66** on the retaliation promise before settling at 89.89 (−0.94% on the Jul 30 print). **Gold +2.49% to 4,135.30** — a genuine safety bid ([CNN live](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/29/world/live-news/iran-trump-news), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/26/what-lies-ahead-for-iran-as-scope-of-us-war-grows-beyond-hormuz)).

## Regime Stage Tracker
- **Current Stage: 5 — Risk-off bearish.** Called on the report's own pre-committed trigger: **VXN through 30 (30.84)**, corroborated by **TQQQ's structure flip to DOWNTURN**, **all five indices red with every drawdown widening**, **a hike-dissent FOMC**, and **the 30Y at a 2007 high**. **Stated honestly: this is not a clean Stage 5.** The definition calls for *VIX > 20 sustained* — VIX pierced 20 and fell back to 19.18 within a session, and credit remains unmeasured. **The transition is being made because the trigger this report named three reads running actually fired, and moving the goalpost after the fact would be worse than being early.**
- **Stage Anchor:** **Jul 29, 2026 — hawkish-dissent FOMC + VXN through 30 + all-index reversal.** (Prior Stage-4 anchor Jul 16, which ran 10 sessions.)
- **Position:** Stage 5, **session 1 — the least-confirmed point of any stage.** **Stage-5 confirmation/deepening 45%** (requires VIX to retake and hold 20, or NDX through −12%, or TQQQ losing $56.82). **Whipsaw back to Stage 4 40%** — materially high, and driven by real evidence: VIX already back to 19.18, NDX futures +1.4%, MSFT +9%, and a vol complex with enormous room to compress if AAPL/AMZN land clean tonight. **Straight to Stage 6 capitulation 5%.** **Stage 3 re-stabilization 10%** (was 28% — a hawkish Fed and a VXN break removed that path for now).
- **Confidence: Medium-Low (cut from Medium).** Reasons for the cut, all real: the stage change rests on a **single completed session**; the **freshest prints (Jul 30) contradict it**; **VIX did not hold 20**; **HY OAS unmeasured for 19 weeks** on the exact day credit stress would matter most; and **RSI/50DMA readings retrieved this read are stale and internally inconsistent** (see the integrity note). What *is* well-evidenced: the TQQQ price, the VXN break, the index closes, and the FOMC outcome.
- **Bullish trigger (→ back to Stage 4, then 3):** **VXN back below 28** would un-fire the trigger that drove this call; **below 25** would restore a stabilization path. Supporting: **VIX holding under 19**, **AAPL + AMZN clearing tonight without a guidance shock**, **NDX drawdown narrowing back inside −9.7%**, and **TQQQ reclaiming ~$60.80** (which restores SIDEWAYS structure).
- **Bearish trigger (→ Stage 5 confirmed / Stage 6):** **VIX back through 20 and CLOSING above it** (19.18 — 0.82 away) OR **NDX through −12%** (−11.6% — **0.4pp away**) OR **TQQQ losing the 13-wk low $56.82** (**−1.6% away**) OR **VXN through 34.37, the 52-week high** (30.84 — 11% away) OR **drawdowns reaching SPX −5% / DJI −4% / Russell −6%** (all re-armed, 0.8–1.4pp away) OR **a 30Y-led yield spike continuing** past the 2007 high OR **HY OAS confirmed through 300 bp (unmeasured, Week 19)** OR **an AAPL/AMZN guidance shock tonight.**

## Regime Verdict
US risk environment **escalates from Stage 4 to Stage 5 with Medium-Low confidence**, on a trigger this report named three reads running and which fired cleanly: **VXN broke 30 to 30.84 (+7.79%), a new episode high, expanding *through* the FOMC rather than crushing after it.** The Fed **held at 3.50–3.75% but 9-3, with three officials dissenting for a HIKE and no forward guidance**; the bond market rejected the message and **sent the 30Y to its highest level since 2007**. The eight-session rotation structure that defined this episode **ended by convergence downward — all five indices red on Jul 29 with DJI the worst performer at −2.19%** — and every drawdown re-widened (**NDX −11.6%, worst of the episode**). **TQQQ closed $57.75, flipping structure to DOWNTURN (−24.0% below the ~$76 4-week high with VXN ≥ 25) and sitting 1.6% above its 13-week low.** Geopolitics escalated: **US strikes on Iran completed, Trump promising retaliation, Brent spiking ~7% intraday, gold +2.49%.** Total falls **−4 → −8**. **The honest caveat, not buried: Jul 30 is rebounding — VIX already back to 19.18, NDX futures +1.4%, MSFT +9% — and VIX never held above 20. Whipsaw risk back to Stage 4 is 40%.**

## Diverging Signals
- **The report's biggest internal conflict, stated plainly: the completed session says Stage 5, the live session says Stage 4.** Jul 29 was uniformly risk-off (all five red, VXN +7.79%, VXN through 30). Jul 30 is a rebound (VIX −7.16% to 19.18, NDX futures +1.4%, SPX +0.17%, MSFT +9%). **The stage change is made on the completed data and the pre-committed trigger; the 40% whipsaw probability is the price of that discipline.** A reader who weighted the freshest prints more heavily would justifiably still be at Stage 4.
- **VIX and VXN split in the most consequential way yet.** VXN **broke through 30 and stayed** (30.84). VIX **pierced 20 and immediately failed** (≈20.66 → 19.18). One index-vol trigger fired and held; the other fired and un-fired. **The Nasdaq vol complex is the stressed one — which is precisely the reader's instrument**, and it is the reason this read is HOSTILE rather than merely cautious.
- **Gold and VIX disagree within the same timestamp.** Both are Jul 30 prints. **VIX −7.16% says the equity fear is draining; Gold +2.49% says capital is still buying protection.** In past episodes gold has been the slower, more stubborn signal. Unresolved, and deliberately not smoothed over.
- **The rotation thesis died — and its death was bearish, not bullish.** For eight sessions this report argued the DJI/NDX spread meant *contained rotation, not flight*. The spread narrowed this read — **because DJI fell 2.19%, the worst of the five.** The benign interpretation is gone; the mechanism that closed the gap was broad de-risking. **This is the report's own central thesis being falsified, and it is being retired explicitly rather than quietly.**
- **A hold that the bond market read as a failure.** The Fed did not hike, yet **the 30Y went to a 2007 high and three officials dissented hawkishly.** Equities and bonds are pricing different things: equity futures recovered overnight, the long end did not. **If the long end is right, the equity rebound is the error.**
- **Blind on credit for nineteen weeks, on the day the 30Y hit a 19-year high.** HY OAS is the single gauge that would adjudicate whether this is a vol event or the leading edge of a funding-stress repricing. **This gap has never mattered more, and it is the largest single reason confidence is Medium-Low rather than Medium.**
